stage: the single-NUCLEUS inventory, under lane-pseudobulk's rule imported unchanged; no RNA value is read and no comparison is run
question: Which of the reader's 13 covered cell types have open SINGLE-NUCLEUS RNA in ENCODE, CELLxGENE or GEO, under the rule lane-pseudobulk committed in `2b9cd0a`, so that the pseudobulk-against-bulk comparison could be run on the single-nucleus subset alone?
why_this_lane_exists: lane-pbrun licensed the modality swap on M2h's endpoint (`22cc987`): AGREEMENT, paired difference +0.00757935 [98.33% CI -0.00243939, +0.0174182] inside the registered margin +-0.0216956, on 8,051 genes across GM12878, K562, ovary and testis. ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR IS SINGLE-NUCLEUS (ovary), which is bile duct's modality, and n = 1 cannot run the registered within-gene permutation, so it licenses nothing on its own. This lane establishes whether the single-nucleus licence CAN be made or CANNOT.

minimum.cell_types_reason: The registered control is M2h's WITHIN-GENE CELL PERMUTATION: a gene's values are permuted among its own cells. With n cells a gene has n! distinct permutations, so n = 4 is the smallest n for which 4! = 24 >= 20 permutations exist and a control p at or below 0.05 is attainable AT ALL. With three or fewer cell types the registered control cannot be run, so the comparison cannot be made as registered and no reading from it would be interpretable.
minimum.genes_reason: M2h's and M2i's registered floor is min_genes = 100, carried verbatim as the endpoint's own floor. 1,000 is the STRICTER floor this lane requires, because what must be resolvable here is not whether the endpoint is positive but whether TWO READINGS OF IT AGREE, and the difference at issue is the size M2h measured (Delta MSE about +0.04, about 2% of variance). Below 1,000 genes the gene bootstrap's interval on the bulk reading alone is wide enough to contain both agreement and disagreement, so the comparison would decide nothing.
minimum.genes_clause: A gene counts toward the 1,000 only if it is in M2h's HELD-OUT population AND resolves in EVERY qualifying cell type in BOTH modalities: exactly one row for its unversioned gene_id in that cell type's bulk table (rows suffixed _PAR_Y not counted), and a row for the same gene in that cell type's pseudobulked single-nucleus matrix. No filter on expression and no filter on any measured value.
minimum.below_either: NO_SOURCE_QUALIFIES, and the lane stops without reading a value. That is a COMPLETE answer: it says the out-of-domain test cannot be made interpretable this way, so the biosample question closes without a lift.

rule_adopted_verbatim.how: every clause and both numbers are lane-pseudobulk's. MINIMUM is IMPORTED from that lane's module rather than copied, as lane-scsweep did it (`sn.MINIMUM is pb.MINIMUM`), so this lane cannot drift from it, and `pb.verdict` is called beside this lane's own to show the two agree. The two cross-archive readings (BIOSAMPLE_IDENTITY_POLICY, TERM_MATCH_POLICY) are IMPORTED from lane-scsweep's module and not restated, for the same reason.

modality_policy: SINGLE-NUCLEUS ONLY, AND A SINGLE-CELL EXPERIMENT DOES NOT COUNT TOWARDS THIS MINIMUM HOWEVER WELL IT CLEARS EVERY OTHER CLAUSE. This is a NARROWING of the adopted single-cell clause, never a relaxation of it: every candidate admitted here would also be admitted by `2b9cd0a`, and candidates `2b9cd0a` admits are dropped here. Each archive states the modality in its own vocabulary and each is read from that archive's own words: (1) ENCODE -- `assay_title` EXACTLY `snRNA-seq`; `scRNA-seq` and `long read scRNA-seq` are single-CELL and are excluded, which is why ENCODE's GM12878 scRNA-seq, admitted by `2b9cd0a` and used by lane-pbrun, is NOT counted here. (2) CELLxGENE -- the schema's own `suspension_type` field EXACTLY `nucleus`; `cell` is excluded, which is why Tabula Sapiens - Testis, admitted by `12b0c4e` and used by lane-pbrun, is NOT counted here. (3) GEO -- no assay vocabulary exists, so the SAMPLE'S OWN WORDS are read and all three must agree: its `library_strategy` is RNA-Seq (which excludes an ATAC arm of the same multiome), and its `extract_protocol`, title or series design says nuclei (`Single nuclei`, `snRNA-seq`, `single-nucleus`, `DroNc-seq`, `snPATHO-seq`) and does not say the library was made from whole cells. The free-text word `nuclei` ALONE in a series summary is not taken as a modality: it matches nuclear extraction and nuclear RNA in bulk assays, and every GEO candidate's modality here comes from its own sample record.
modality_is_a_narrowing_not_a_relaxation: Every candidate admitted here would also be admitted by `2b9cd0a`; candidates `2b9cd0a` admits are DROPPED here. A narrowing cannot inflate a count, so this lane's number can only be smaller than its predecessors'.
biosample_identity_policy: The adopted single-cell clause requires the single-cell experiment's BIOSAMPLE to be the covered cell type. Applied to an archive with no `biosample_term_name` field, that is read as biosample IDENTITY and nothing wider: the cells the candidate file holds must BE the covered cell type, not a tissue that contains it and not a related type. A whole dissociated tissue counts for a covered type that IS a tissue -- `ovary`, `testis` -- which is exactly the relation of the ENCODE `ovary` snRNA-seq experiments lane-pseudobulk itself ADMITTED, and it does NOT count for a covered type that is a cell, because selecting that cell type's annotated subset out of a tissue is the cell-composition decision the adopted rule does not license. A purified or cultured preparation of the covered cell type DOES count, because its biosample is that cell type.
term_match_policy: The adopted clause says EXACTLY, and what that word protects is stated in the rule's own `covered_set` clause: the covered set is NOT re-derived and NOT widened. It guards against admitting a cell type that is not in the thirteen; it cannot be read as a requirement that another archive spell a cell type the way ENCODE spells it, because no other archive has the field. So BOTH counts are reported and neither is hidden: `exact_label_count` admits a candidate only when the archive's own label is the IDENTICAL STRING to the covered biosample_term_name, and `same_biosample_count` also admits one whose label is a different string for the same biosample (`CD14+ Monocytes` for `CD14-positive monocyte`). The headline count of this lane is the STRICTER of the two, `exact_label_count`.
answer_means: The modality swap lane-pbrun licensed (`22cc987`) is licensed FOR SINGLE-CELL PSEUDOBULK ONLY on M2h's endpoint: three of its four cell types are single-CELL and only ovary is single-NUCLEUS, and n = 1 cannot run the registered within-gene permutation. This lane searched ENCODE, CELLxGENE and GEO for single-NUCLEUS RNA of the covered cell types under `2b9cd0a`'s rule imported unchanged, and found fewer than the minimum of 4. So the single-nucleus-only comparison CANNOT BE REGISTERED OR RUN, bile duct's single-nucleus test stays UNINTERPRETABLE -- it would change the cell type and the assay modality at once -- and THE BIOSAMPLE QUESTION CLOSES WITHOUT A LIFT. The minimum was not stretched, no single-CELL experiment was counted towards it, and no weaker test was proposed to rescue it.
pseudobulk_verdict_note: lane-pseudobulk's own function returns NO_SOURCE_QUALIFIES on a None gene count BY CONSTRUCTION, whatever the cell count: that is the ordered form of its rule and it is reprinted here so no reader mistakes this lane for having counted the genes. The cell-type half is what this lane settles.
count_against_the_minimum: 1 of 13 covered cell types on the headline exact-label count, 2 of 13 on the wider same-biosample count, against a minimum of 4
predecessor_note: lane-scsweep counted 4 cell types (`12b0c4e`) and lane-pbrun ran on them. Of those four, the ones this lane cannot count are single-CELL: that difference is the modality clause and NOT a disagreement about any other clause.

rejected.why: THIS IS THE CLOSEST THING IN GEO TO SINGLE-NUCLEUS RNA OF THE COVERED CELL LINES AND IT CANNOT BE ADMITTED. SNARE-seq profiled 1,047 nuclei of a FOUR-LINE MIXTURE -- BJ, H1, K562 and GM12878 -- and the archive publishes ONE cDNA count table for the mixture, with no per-line split declared. Taking the K562 (or H1, or GM12878) barcodes out of it needs a per-barcode cell-line assignment the archive does not make, which is exactly the cell-identity decision the adopted rule does not license. The contrast is lane-scsweep's own K562 candidate, GSM9224207, which WAS admitted from a human/mouse mixture precisely BECAUSE the submitter split the supplementary files per line. Nuclei isolation is not a treatment and nothing here is modified: the biosample is a mixture of four cell lines, and that is the whole reason.

A single-nucleus RNA library of GM12878 alone, which is what this lane needed, and the series' own design reads `GM12878 cells were freshly fixed with 1% formaldehyde` and the nuclei `fixed with 1% formaldehyde` before the protocol. Fixation is a treatment of the material, which is the clause on which lane-scsweep rejected the PFA-fixed half of its own K562 sample (`12b0c4e`). The same clause is applied here to the cell type where it costs this lane the most.

geo_count_caveat: These counts are FREE-TEXT matches on ENCODE's own term string under single-NUCLEUS-only terms, because GEO has no biosample vocabulary and no assay vocabulary to ask. A count here says how much was available to look through and NOTHING about what qualifies: `SK-N-SH` answered 3 at the sample level and 7 at the series level, and the one GEO candidate this lane admits on any clause was found through the SERIES-level search and not the sample-level one. The bare word `nuclei` was deliberately left out of the query, because it matches nuclear extraction and nuclear RNA in bulk assays.
what_a_listing_is: An archive listing is what is PUBLISHED, not what is USABLE. No experimental data file was fetched: each candidate file's openness is an HTTP HEAD -- a status and a byte count -- and its per-gene-per-nucleus content is taken from the archive's own declaration of the file, not from reading it.
what_was_not_searched: GEO exhaustively: it has no assay vocabulary and no common quantification, so the negatives here are about the named queries and the submissions they surfaced, not about the archive

the 10x public datasets and the HCA data portal beyond what lane-pseudobulk and lane-scsweep recorded: both were re-examined against the MODALITY clause from those lanes' own records and neither holds a single-NUCLEUS library of a covered cell type
dbGaP and EGA, excluded by the adopted licence clause
any matrix's gene content: the adopted minimum's 1,000-gene clause is uncounted here
wording_limit: Agreement on this endpoint licenses the modality swap FOR THIS ENDPOINT ONLY. It is never 'single-nucleus RNA equals bulk RNA', and it is never a statement about any other endpoint, any other gene set or any cell type not counted here.
no_biosample_added: This lane adds NO biosample. It works only in cell types the reader already covers, makes no AlphaGenome request and no deletion request, and touches nothing in area J, no node model and no BioForge calibration.
stop_list_check: ROADMAP section 5, the stop list of 2026-09-27 reinstated: no biosample is added, only cell types the reader already covers are looked at, no AlphaGenome and no deletion request is made, nothing in area J is touched, no node-model work and no BioForge calibration.

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
